name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 3px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast. It’s the only option that survives color inversion and reduced-motion modes without breaking visual clarity. The trade-off is slightly larger touch targets on mobile, but that improves usability for everyone.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring at 4.5:1 still fails on monochrome displays where the ring blends into busy backgrounds. A 2px ring at 7:1 contrast survives monochrome but risks blending into low-contrast interfaces. Settle it with a user test: measure ring visibility on monochrome and low-contrast backgrounds for both options.
